token.title: SwitchBot Token
token.description: Open SwitchBot app > Profile > Preferences > Developer Options to obtain your token.

secret.title: SwitchBot Secret
secret.description: Secret key paired with your token (Developer Options).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll device status. Minimum 60s to respect the cloud rate limit (10000 req/day).

botMode.title: Bot Mode
botMode.description: How a SwitchBot Bot is controlled: 'switch' uses turnOn/turnOff, 'press' sends a momentary press for both on and off.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Debug only.
